subject: gbrain
tagline: Postgres-native personal knowledge brain with hybrid RAG search (PGLite default, Supabase optional)

capabilities.name: Hybrid search (vector + keyword + RRF)
capabilities.description: Busca hibrida com RRF, expansao multi-query e dedup

capabilities.name: Pluggable engines (PGLite default, Postgres/Supabase optional)
capabilities.description: Engine factory com dynamic import, PGLite embutido via WASM ou Postgres remoto

capabilities.name: Self-wiring knowledge graph (zero-LLM auto-link)
capabilities.description: Extracao de tipos (attended, works_at, invested_in) via heuristicas, sem LLM

capabilities.name: Eval harness retrieval
capabilities.description: P@k, R@k, MRR, nDCG@k com benchmark BrainBench publicado

capabilities.name: Minions durable job queue (Postgres-native)
capabilities.description: Job queue BullMQ-inspired com parent-child, cascade-kill, idempotency

capabilities.name: MCP server (30+ tools via stdio + HTTP)
capabilities.description: Exposes ~41 brain operations como MCP tools

capabilities.name: Query intent classifier
capabilities.description: Classifica entity/temporal/event/general com detail level auto

capabilities.name: Deterministic fail-improve loop
capabilities.description: JSONL failure logging com regex generation a partir de falhas

capabilities.name: Timeline temporal entries
capabilities.description: parseTimelineEntries com batch insert via unnest

capabilities.name: Orphans detector
capabilities.description: Surface pages sem wikilinks inbound, agrupado por dominio

unique_selling_points: Zero-LLM auto-link: relacionamentos tipados extraidos por heuristicas, sem chamar LLM em cada write
PGLite default: database pronto em 2s, sem servidor, embutido via WASM
BrainBench publicado: R@5 83% -> 95% com hybrid + graph, graph-only F1 86.6% vs grep 57.8%
Minions job queue: 753ms vs 10s+ em sub-agents, durability via Postgres com cascade-kill
Thin harness, fat skills: 26 skills markdown sao o motor, runtime e magro

limitations.description: Paraphrase-first storage: compiled_truth e o primario, raw fica em raw_data
